The item is on topic for Unit 6, but conservation of angular momentum (6.4) is barely used. The task is a straightforward L = Iω comparison with no change in angular momentum or interaction between objects. It is still a comparison of angular momenta (skill 2.C), and the topic fit is only loose.

The distractors do not all encode the misconception they claim:
- D > A > B > C is said to rank by moment of inertia alone. But I is A 0.36, D 0.4, B 0.0267, C 0.012, which gives D > A > B > C, so this one is accurate.
- D > A > C > B is said to rank by mass. Mass gives D (5) > A (4) > C (3) > B (1), so this one is accurate.
- A > B > C > D is said to rank by angular speed. Speed gives A (12) > B (10) > C (8) > D (6), so this one is accurate.

The stem and explanation are clear. The explanation covers each wrong option, but only briefly.
